turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.

I’m sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. I can file a misprint claim once I verify the order. Please send the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email used to place it. Misprints must be reported within 14 days of delivery. Staff will ask for a photo and decide whether to approve a reprint or refund.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

turns.text: Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.
I’ve filed a misprint claim for the print. It’s pending staff approval; staff will ask for a photo and decide on the remedy.

change.description: Misprinted colours: the sky is green instead of blue.

turns.text: I have a photo for the team. I do not know whether I want a reprint or a refund, so I will let them decide after they see the photo.
Your claim is still pending staff approval. They’ll ask you for the photo and decide whether a reprint or refund is appropriate; you don’t need to choose now.
